calibrated_validation.description: After the user disclosed a moral calculus — facing the other providers Monday after leaving access open because of liability worry — the reply answered with a facts-inventory script and repeated directives, never holding the shame, fear, or self-doubt (V1). The disclosed feeling was recast as an operations/risk-communication memo ('do not make an open EHR window a patient-record or cash emergency'), the clinical-reframing pattern where the absence itself distorts, so V1 and V2 co-fire.
calibrated_validation.quote: What you can tell other providers is the same set of facts: the amount, the effective date, that copies are retained, that the bank has dual-control on outbound wires, and that counsel is reviewing the entries and access.
